motivation: Investigate diagnostic overhead and ADMM penalty sensitivity observed in original formal study; no test-based tuning
baseline_handling: rho=1/check_every=1 baseline is shared across the two analyses within this run; all compared timings are measured contemporaneously
main_protocol: unchanged; no new parameters selected for primary results
diagnostic_cost: Every scheduled check uses the same feasible dual gap. Check at iteration zero and at cap even when not divisible by frequency.
aggregation: median over 3 timings per data problem/setting; then mean and sample SD across 5 data seeds
scope: Synthetic n_train=1000,p=200 from original frozen formal study; no additional dataset or model tuning
